title: Parva
desc: Sagar, a singer-turned-alcoholic, decides to mend his ways and rekindle his passion after falling in love with Suma. However, all hell breaks loose when she does not turn up for his concert.

title: O Premave
desc: Raja, a young man, crosses paths with Prema and falls in love with her. However, their union is opposed by her father, who wishes her to get married to a man of his choice.

title: Snehana Preethina
desc: The rich fathers of Adi and Lakshmi hatch a plot to separate them from their poor respective lovers, Sindhu and Soorya. However, Adi soon realises the truth and decides to set things right.

title: Choo Mantar
desc: Paranormal team explores haunted Morgan House for treasure, unaware of its dark history of greed, betrayal, and tragic deaths.

title: Prakambanam
desc: Three university roommates handle intense student elections and practical jokes inside their Ernakulam accommodation. However, an unexpected incident upends their routine.

title: Bhajarangi 2
desc: An evil drug baron named Araka kidnaps innocent villagers and forces them to produce drugs for him. Fortunately, a forest officer learns of this and decides to put a stop to it.
